use_cases: Developer Q&A platforms similar to Stack Overflow
Community forum question and answer display
Knowledge base article with author attribution
Discussion thread with vote counts and accepted answers
ai_summary: A Stack Overflow-style Q&A interface component featuring question display with vote counts, answer listings, accepted answer highlighting, and user avatars. Uses Radix UI primitives for accessibility and follows a flat, minimalist design pattern suitable for developer communities and technical support platforms.
